name: Corporate Identity
summary: White and grey panels, a confident brand-colour band and a glazed office entrance.

design_language.style: professional corporate industrial campus in Vietnam with a clear arrival identity
design_language.office_material: large shaded curtain-wall glazing at the office
design_language.accent: brand-colour band along the eave and at entrance bays

environment.weather: bright tropical late morning with scattered cumulus

presentation.landscape_character: rows of tropical shade trees (sao đen, dầu, bàng) along roads and boundaries; ordered palms and flowering shrubs at the arrival court
presentation.paving_character: dark asphalt on every external and perimeter road; light-grey industrial concrete with joints, drainage and light dust on internal yards and loading aprons

brief.roof_type: symmetric low-slope gable profiled-metal roof fitted inside LOD100 envelope
